title: Agentflow test run frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of a test run record at features/<batch>/testing/<project>-<feature-slug>/run-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<NNN>.md — one execution round against a pinned test plan version. Each round is one new file; corrections edit the record in place and refresh updated_at. Findings become issue records and are referenced by bug_id.

project.description: Slug of the repository or project under test — must match the referenced plan's project.

test_plan_version.description: The plan's test_version at execution time. Coverage against the current registry is only asserted when this equals the plan's current version.

target_revision.description: Commit of the target repository that was actually tested — may differ from the plan's target_revision; the run record is the provenance of its own results.

environment.description: Where and how it ran: origin, automation route (scripted Playwright / host browser via supervisor / API), account role. Never carries credentials.

credentials.description: How credentials reached the executor (e.g. 'session-injected env, never persisted'). Values are forbidden here and anywhere in the body.

summary_pass.description: Case count with result pass; the checker asserts equality with the 结果 table. Frontmatter values are strings by contract.

summary_fail.description: Case count with result fail; the checker asserts equality with the 结果 table.

summary_blocked.description: Case count with result blocked; the checker asserts equality with the 结果 table.

summary_not_run.description: Case count with result not-run; the checker asserts equality with the 结果 table.

decision.description: pass requires zero fail and zero blocked in the summary; the checker enforces this.

findings.description: bug_ids of the defect records filed from this run; each must exist under issues/.

flow_findings.description: bug_ids of flow-reasonableness findings filed from this run (missing timeout/duplicate/interrupt handling, inconsistent error semantics, unhandled states); each must exist under issues/.
